producer_report.summary: Added the pure scope_guard module (line grouping by union-find, named threshold constants, T1 to T5, evaluate_before_attempt, replay tests for the trailer, speedup, prompt-budget and cut A cases). Exported it from lib.rs. Marked D127 accepted with the two changes, and updated scope-guard.md (status, sections 8 and 13) and CHANGELOG.md. On this send-back I changed no files. I only re-ran the three checks.

checks_run.note: Ran to completion with no error reported by the tool. The output was 108KB and was saved to a file outside my working directory, which the policy hook would not let me read. I could not read the per-suite 'test result' lines, so 'all pass' rests on the absence of an error, not on a count.

criteria_check.criterion: cargo test -p athena-core scope_guard passes. Tests build records for the trailer, test-suite speedup, prompt-budget and cut A cases and assert which of T1 to T5 fire and before which attempt, matching the section 5.1 table (speedup: T4 fires after the 2nd rejection; cut A: T1 flag with no pause because criteria differ; prompt-budget: T5 flag at 60 minutes).
criteria_check.evidence: I wrote the replay tests in scope_guard.rs for the four cases. They ran inside the passing workspace `cargo test --locked`. I did not read the per-test result lines on this send-back.

criteria_check.criterion: A T4 test fails if the same-criterion comparison is removed or made always-true: a case with two rejections of different criteria must not fire T4 (checkable by reading the test and, if desired, mutating the comparison and running cargo test -p athena-core scope_guard).
criteria_check.evidence: The module has a different-criteria test asserting T4 is not Pause. The speedup test asserts Pause when the criteria match and only the numbers differ. I did not run a mutation.

criteria_check.criterion: Line grouping puts a request, its retries and any request that quotes it into one line. T4 normalises criterion text to lower case with numbers removed and returns a maybe result (flag, not pause) on an unclear match. The thresholds in section 5 (T1 3rd attempt, T2 1.5x or 3rd planning round, T3 1.0x/1.5x p90 and $5, T4 two rejections, T5 60/120 minutes) are named constants.
criteria_check.evidence: Grouping, normalisation and maybe tests exist in scope_guard.rs. The constants T1_ATTEMPT, T2_RATIO, T2_PLANNING_ROUND, T3_FLAG_RATIO, T3_PAUSE_RATIO, T3_LINE_DOLLARS, T4_REJECTIONS, T5_FLAG_MINUTES and T5_PAUSE_MINUTES are defined there.

criteria_check.criterion: scope_guard.rs does no I/O: it uses no std::fs, process, network or clock calls, and takes time and spend as input data. It is exported from crates/athena-core/src/lib.rs.
criteria_check.evidence: The module takes minutes and dollars as struct fields. lib.rs has `pub mod scope_guard;`, and the crate compiles under clippy and test. I did not re-grep the file for forbidden APIs on this send-back.

open_issues: The T4 maybe rule (containment or majority-word overlap) is my choice, because the design says only 'unclear'.
A rejected attempt with no recorded unmet criterion is treated as Maybe. The design does not say what to do.
The cut A and trailer per-attempt figures are even splits, and the cut A criterion text is invented for the tests.
mistakes: On this send-back I could not confirm the test totals. Running `cargo test --locked` a second time with `-q` would have kept the output small, but it takes 9 to 11 minutes and the brief says to run the suite at most once.
learnings: The full workspace test output is large (about 108KB). The tool saves it to a path outside the working directory, which the policy hook refuses to let me read.
desires: Tool output saved to a file that I am allowed to read, so I can confirm test totals.
